label: Claude Code

settings.valueNote: autoCompactWindow is 558000 so compaction lands at 525000, because this harness offsets it: read from the 2.1.236 binary, the headless runner compacts when tokens exceed Jir(model, autoCompactWindow), which is min(modelWindow, autoCompactWindow) minus min(model max output, 20000) minus 13000. claude-opus-5 reports a 1M window and a 64000 output default, so the offset is a flat 33000. Two consequences worth knowing before changing it: the setting can only shrink the window, never grow it, and a CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS under 20000 in a provider env would raise the real point. omp spells the same idea as a literal threshold instead, so its numbers need no offset.
settings.limitsNote: a seat's tool limits are this file's permissions.deny and sandbox, which hold in bypassPermissions, the mode Paseo launches these seats in, and load because the room forces --setting-sources user and this file is the user source. Verified on 2.1.236 with claude -p against a scratch config directory: a bare tool name in permissions.deny takes the tool out of the model's context; sandbox.enabled with allowUnsandboxedCommands false refused a Bash write outside the working directory and allowed one inside it, a git commit and an HTTPS request; an Edit deny rule refused a Write to that path. permissions.ask with Skill(skill:NAME) holds in that mode too, where Skill(NAME) matches nothing: through the orchestrator the call waits as a permission request for the agent that started the seat. The kit sets no such rule, because a role uses its own skills on its own judgment. A sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite entry beats an allowWrite inside it, so a write allow-list inside the repository cannot be said here, and which repository files a role writes stays in its prompt. Bash rules match the command text, as omp's patterns do; the sandbox is what holds a write whatever the command looks like.

state.mcpNote: $servers is seats.json's mcpServers map, passed in by setup-seats.fish. The seat gets those at user scope in its own .claude.json and nothing else: project-scoped servers stay cleared, because a repository could otherwise hand a seat a server the kit never chose.

skillLoad.placeholdersNote: substitutions this harness performs. setup-seats.fish refuses every harness's placeholders in every skill, because a skill has to load unchanged where none of them are substituted.

probe.live: run probe.command with the seat's configDirEnv set and ask it to list its skills
probe.note: the skills directory and symlink following were verified by running a seat against a scratch profile; a version other than the verified one re-opens that question

provider.defaultModelNote: the model a role on this harness gets when seats.json names none and --model is not passed. Spelled the way this harness spells a model: omp wants provider/id.

baseCredential.note: set on the base provider so every seat inherits it through extends. The kit never reads it from anywhere but the user.

provider.commandNote: every harness launches through the shared room, which forces forceFlags and execs the binary in provider.env.SEATWORKS_AGENT_BIN. The Paseo plugin, not the room, resolves the project from the agent's working directory and sets configDirEnv to that project's seat directory, because a provider's env is the same for every project.
provider.forceFlagsNote: flags the room replaces in the argv the orchestrator built, or appends when absent, because the kit writes the provider but not its arguments. --setting-sources user drops the repository own .claude/settings.json and .claude/skills/ while keeping the seat own settings.json, which is the user source: measured from this harness debug log, user,project,local loads 2 skills (user: 1, project: 1) and user loads 1 (user: 1, project: 0), and the watch list names the seat file first. Without it a repository adds skills, settings and permission rules to a seat that no hidesWords check and no skill set ever saw.

promptCommentsNote: informational. Every .md in this kit is comment-free so it loads unchanged on every harness; setup refuses `<!--` whatever this says. A safety review reads it to know whether a leaked note would reach the seat.
userSettingsNote: the user's own settings file. setup-seats.fish requires each role settings file to carry the same settings.retentionKey value, because a seat prunes the shared directories in links on startup.
retiredLinksNote: links this harness once made and must not have now. setup deletes each one from every seat directory, because build_seat_links only creates what links declares and would otherwise leave a retired symlink in place. plugins is retired because no seat uses a plugin: the Human asked for none, both LSP plugins were enabled on seats whose settings deny the LSP tool, they ship no skills, and installed_plugins.json recorded their install path inside a profile directory the kit had stopped creating.
